text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired -> service=inference-gateway, region=us-west1, alert=5xx_rate > 5% (6.4%), agg_window=60s. Pager: oncall-sre. Links: https://monitoring.redwood/runtime/alert/3532109876

alex: acked. looking now. any obvious deploys?

priya: not seeing any rollout in the last 10m. LB shows a spike in backend 502/503, lots of upstream connection resets.

maria: tracing shows increased tail latency on envoy->worker mux. sampling: https://traces.redwood/trace/0af3...  some flows show kv-cache miss floods.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. allocating timebox 30m. first steps: reroute traffic away from us-west1 circuit to fallback region, and enable additional workers in pool.

alex: confirming can we safe-scale GPU pool? Dedicated has headroom but we need autoscale policy override. devops-bot, can you spin extra replicas?

devops-bot: runbook task triggered: scale-inference-pool --region us-west1 --delta +8 replicas. Job id: job-5532. ETA 45s.

priya: logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-14T03:04:12Z] proxy: upstream reset by peer, code=RST_STREAM
[2026-03-14T03:04:13Z] runtime: kv-cache eviction spike, miss-rate=0.72
[2026-03-14T03:04:14Z] worker[12]: oom_kill? oom_score_adj changed
```
Noticed a small batch of OOMs on worker VMs 12-14. could be memory regression from yesterday's micro-optim.

maria: adding temporary rate-limit to long-running streaming endpoints to reduce mem pressure: applied `route:/v1/stream` token-burst=30/s -> 10/s in edge config.

pagerbot: pagerduty: page acknowledged by alex at 03:05:07 UTC. Escalation paused.

alex: good mitigation. i'm going to cordon instances 12-14 and drain them. if OOMs are due to the latest artifact, we should rollback.

oncall-sre: agreed. priya, can you correlate deploys -> artifact ids -> worker pool?

priya: artifact 2026.03.13.19:07 made it to canary two nights ago and rolled to us-west1 at 02:40 UTC. Worker pool version matches that.

maria: can we confirm model-cache warmup? looks like KV-cache miss storm correlated to new quantization flags. might be a runtime regression.

alex: I'm draining the nodes now. `kubectl drain node/ip-10-0-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (running).

devops-bot: node ip-10-0-12 cordon+drain completed. new nodes joining pool (3 pending).

pagerbot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: alert rate dropping: 5xx_rate now 2.1% (window 60s).

oncall-sre: nice. maintain throttles and keep scaling until mem pressure normalizes. we'll keep this thread for mitigation notes.

alex: rollback candidate prepared: rollback to artifact 2026.03.12.11:22 if errors resurge. Need approval for canary rollback? Priya, maria?

priya: approve rollback if we see >4% sustained for 5m. For now continue to monitor.

maria: putting a watch on customer-facing streaming sessions. Early signals show 0.7% decreased successful streams in us-west1 for last 5m — customer impact small but meaningful. notifying support to prepare status updates.

pagerbot: autopager follow-up: escalation to manager scheduled at 03:18 UTC if unacked/underdressed. (currently acked)

devops-bot: autoscaling completed. pool capacity increased +8 replicas. memory pressure per-node metric dropping.

alex: nodes recovered, no immediate OOMs reported after drain. logs show GC chatter but stable.

oncall-sre: plan: keep scaled capacity for next 45m, remove temporary rate-limit after 20m if stable, create post-incident ticket to investigate kv-cache change and recent quantization flags. owner: priya.

priya: creating ticket INC-20260314-001 investigating kv-cache miss spike + quantization flags correlation. adding logs/traces.

maria: support: posting a short note to status page draft — waiting on severity confirmation.

alex: thanks team. final note: hold rollback unless we see second spike. We'll reconvene in 30m if anything changes. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: alert resolved automatically at 03:16:09 UTC (5xx_rate < threshold). Closing autopage but thread remains for follow-ups.

oncall-sre: closing loop — I'll run the RCA template and ping owners. great job on fast mitigation.

maria: adding follow-up action: add regression test for kv-cache miss scenarios to prevent future regressions.

priya: uploading heapdump and trace bundle to the ticket.

alex: leaving final note here: customer impact minimal, no data lost, mitigation performed (drain+scale+temp-rate-limit). switching to monitoring-only.

pagerbot: Incident summary (auto): service=inference-gateway, region=us-west1, root-cause=kv-cache miss storm likely triggered by new quantization runtime flag, mitigation=drain affected nodes + scale pool + temporary rate-limit, status=monitoring, owner=priya, incident-id=INC-20260314-001.
